properties.textContent: :root{--dp-ink:#19212A;--dp-muted:#5F6C76;--dp-faint:#8B97A1;--dp-border:#E4E9ED;} .dp-local{--dp-accent:#0FA39D;--dp-tint:#E6F6F5;} .dp-shared{--dp-accent:#2E6FA7;--dp-tint:#E7F1F9;} .dp-zhead{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px 0 12px 16px;border-left:3px solid var(--dp-accent);margin-top:26px;} .dp-badge{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:9px;flex:none;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--dp-tint);color:var(--dp-accent);font-size:16px;} .dp-ztitle{font-size:15px;font-weight:650;color:var(--dp-ink);} .dp-zsub{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--dp-muted);margin-top:1px;} .dp-zcount{margin-left:auto;font-size:12px;color:var(--dp-muted);} .dp-toggle-all{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-left:14px;font:inherit;font-size:12px;font-weight:550;cursor:pointer;color:var(--dp-accent);background:transparent;border:0;padding:5px 8px;border-radius:7px;} .dp-toggle-all:hover{background:var(--dp-tint);} .dp-newfolder{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:8px;margin:2px 0 10px;} .dp-folder{background:#FCFDFE;border:1px solid var(--dp-border);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(20,30,40,.05),0 4px 14px rgba(20,30,40,.05);overflow:hidden;margin:0 0 12px;} .dp-folder>summary{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:12px;cursor:pointer;user-select:none;background:#F1F5F7;list-style:none;border-bottom:1px solid transparent;} .dp-folder[open]>summary{border-bottom-color:var(--dp-border);} .dp-folder>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none;} .dp-folder>summary::before{content:'\25B8';color:var(--dp-faint);font-size:12px;display:inline-block;width:12px;transition:transform .16s;} .dp-folder[open]>summary::before{transform:rotate(90deg);} .dp-folder>*:not(summary){display:none;} .dp-folder[open]>*:not(summary){display:block;} .dp-fico{color:var(--dp-accent);} .dp-fname{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--dp-ink);} .dp-none .dp-fname{color:var(--dp-muted);} .dp-none .dp-fico{color:var(--dp-faint);} .dp-count{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--dp-muted);background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--dp-border);border-radius:999px;padding:1px 8px;min-width:22px;text-align:center;} .dp-spacer{margin-left:auto;} .dp-agents{padding:12px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:10px;} .dp-folder sp-card{margin:0!important;width:100%;} .dp-empty{padding:12px 14px;color:var(--dp-faint);font-size:13px;font-style:italic;} sp-popover{min-width:250px;} sp-popover sp-menu{min-width:250px;}
